title: ONGC Gets US Licence for Venezuela Operations

blocks.content: Oil and Natural Gas Corp (ONGC), a state-owned Indian oil and gas company, secured a licence from the United States Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) to resume full oil-field operations in Venezuela. The approval covers ONGC’s overseas investment arm, ONGC Videsh Ltd (OVL), and relates to its participation in Venezuelan upstream oil projects.

items: Venezuela has one of the world’s largest proven crude oil reserves, estimated at about 303 billion barrels.
Petroleos de Venezuela S.A. is commonly known as PDVSA and is the national oil company of Venezuela.
OFAC stands for the Office of Foreign Assets Control and functions under the United States Department of the Treasury.
ONGC Videsh Ltd is the foreign investment arm of Oil and Natural Gas Corp.
